title: 第二十二章 神域秘史背叛真相第二十一章 六命归一天启初启
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 晚霞浸染了琉光星冕学园的每一条林荫路，暖融融的金红霞光穿过枝叶缝隙，在地面投下斑驳错落的光影。六人的身影并肩而行，方才在学生会会议室里倾诉的沉重过往，依旧沉甸甸萦绕在每个人心头。夜见幽弥将埋藏五年的伤痛与阴谋尽数道出，众人同心立誓要为她讨回公道，可夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲潜藏的强横实力，又让所有人清楚知晓，眼下绝非贸然出手的时机。
晚风卷着草木独有的清浅香气拂过肩头，走在队伍中段的夜见幽弥微微垂着眼帘，幽紫渐变的长发被风轻轻撩动。手腕上那枚红紫渐变爱心手链紧贴肌肤，温润的灵力缓缓流淌，持续抚平她心底翻涌的戾气与酸涩。五年的伪装与隐忍一朝卸下，被同伴全然接纳、真心守护的暖意，一点点消融着她周身多年不散的孤冷。她侧过头，目光不经意间对上身旁御神苍瞬的视线，对方霆蓝渐变的眼眸澄澈平静，没有探究，没有怜悯，只有全然的理解与信任。
御神苍瞬自幼亲历神域崩塌、族人尽亡的惨剧，同样背负着满目疮痍的过往，她比任何人都明白被命运裹挟、被黑暗算计的痛苦。两人目光短暂交汇，无需言语，便已然读懂彼此心底的万千心绪。御神苍瞬率先收回视线，视线望向远方连绵的楼宇，清冷的嗓音缓缓响起。
“仅凭言语推断与零散的灵力探查，我们依旧无法看清暗樱女王完整的布局。夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲扎根暗影多年，实力隐藏极深，单单知晓幽弥的遭遇，不足以拼凑出所有真相。三年前那场席卷整片神域的浩劫，看似是域外战乱与暗影入侵交织而成的灾难，可结合今日得知的阴谋细细思索，其中处处透着蹊跷。”
这番话瞬间让前行的几人停下脚步，原本松弛下来的氛围再度变得凝重。天野凛星敛去眼底转瞬即逝的温柔，冰蓝色的眼眸覆上一层锐利的审视，作为全队的战术核心，他第一时间捕捉到话语里的关键信息。
“你的意思是，三年前全域神域覆灭、各大王族流离失散的浩劫，从一开始就不是单纯的势力纷争，而是暗樱女王一手策划的巨大阴谋？”
“不止如此。”御神苍瞬缓步向前踏出两步，周身开始萦绕起淡淡的霆蓝时序雷光，细碎的电光在发丝与衣袂间游走闪烁，“我的本源执掌时间与雷霆之力，能够借助灵力回溯过往的时光碎片。幽弥拥有幻影与暗影双生本源，幻境之力可以搭建连通过往与当下的虚实通道。若是我们二人力量相融，便能跨越岁月阻隔，完整重现三年前神域发生的一切。”
夜见幽弥闻言，周身幽紫的幻影灵力随之升腾而起，半透明的光影在她身侧层层叠叠舒展，虚实交错的纹路在空中勾勒出朦胧的屏障。“幻影之力搭建时空幻境，承接你的时序回溯，双力联动，的确可以追溯到三年前神域大战的全过程。如今全员羁绊共鸣，天启本源已然扎根，我们的力量相融不会出现灵力紊乱的隐患，正好借此机会，揭开所有被岁月掩埋的秘辛。”
藤咲若织上前半步，绛红渐变的眼眸满是郑重，周身草木与烈焰交织的灵力悄然铺开，形成一圈温和的防护结界笼罩众人。“我们一同前往，所有人亲眼见证过往真相。暗樱女王的野心布局牵扯甚广，唯有看清全部始末，我们后续的布局与反击，才能做到万无一失。涟音、金朵，你们二人做好防御与续航准备，一旦回溯过程中遭遇过往残留的暗黑戾气袭击，立刻撑起联合护盾。”
海月涟音轻轻点头，苍碧色的水风灵力环绕周身流转，海浪与清风交织成柔韧的屏障雏形。琉璃金朵粉金色的岩土灵光稳稳扎根地面，金石纹路顺着地面蔓延，将整片区域牢牢锁定，杜绝外界干扰。“放心吧若织学姐，防御和治愈交给我们，不会让大家在回溯途中受到伤害。”
六人呈合围之势站在林荫道中央，彼此之间的灵力脉络相互衔接，六域本源按照天启星阵的轨迹缓缓流转。冰金圣光、绛红火灵、苍碧水风、粉金岩土、幽紫幻影、霆蓝时序，六道色彩鲜明的灵力缠绕交织，形成一座半透明的复合型光阵。天地间的天启星光悄然洒落，融入光阵之中，为这份跨越时光的力量再添一层稳固的保障。
“准备好了吗？”御神苍瞬看向身侧的夜见幽弥，霆蓝的眼眸神色认真。
“随时可以开始。”夜见幽弥微微颔首，指尖微动，幽紫幻影之力率先铺展，半透明的幻境领域以两人为中心向外扩散，周遭的景物开始微微扭曲，空气里泛起层层叠叠的涟漪。
下一刻，御神苍瞬抬起双手，掌心升腾起浓郁的霆蓝雷光，时序之力顺着光阵纹路全线铺开。“时电溯流，启！”
轰鸣般的低响在幻境内部响起，无形的时光之力拉扯着所有人的感知，眼前的现代学园景象如同破碎的镜面一般层层剥落。暖霞、香樟、教学楼、林荫小道尽数消散，取而代之的是广袤无垠、气势磅礴的上古神域天地。
视线所及之处，琼楼玉宇凌空而立，浮空山峦连绵不绝，天地间充盈着纯粹浓郁的本源灵力，各色王族专属的力量光晕在天际交织，一派繁荣鼎盛、祥和安宁的景象。这里便是三年前尚未遭遇浩劫的整片神域，六大王族分域而居，世代相守，彼此守望，共同维系着神域与人间两界的秩序平衡。
众人的身形化作无形的光影，漂浮在半空之中，作为旁观者俯瞰整片神域，不会干涉过往的任何轨迹，却能将眼前发生的一切看得一清二楚。
最先映入眼帘的，是暝夜璃影王族的领地。幽紫色的光影遍布整片领地，幻影与暗影之力交织成独特的守护结界，彼时年少的伊瑟拉尚且眉眼明媚，周身没有半分后来的孤傲与冷冽。她身形灵动地穿梭在族地之间，和同族之人谈笑风生，眼底满是纯粹的笑意与对未来的憧憬。那时的她还未遇见夜狩凌朔，还未踏入那场精心编织的骗局，依旧拥有属于自己的温暖与归属。
看着昔日模样的自己，夜见幽弥的身形微微一滞，指尖不自觉收紧，心底翻涌着复杂难言的情绪。藤咲若织察觉到她的异样，悄悄挪动光影靠近，无声地抬手，用草木灵力化作一缕轻柔的暖意安抚她躁动的心绪。夜见幽弥侧头看向她，微微摇头，示意自己并无大碍，目光重新落向下方的景象。
画面流转，时光继续向前推移。伊瑟拉走出暝夜璃影王族领地，在神域交界的市集之中，第一次遇见了刻意伪装温柔的夜狩凌朔。彼时的男子眉眼温润，谈吐谦和，一举一动都恰到好处地流露着体贴与关怀，一步步靠近孤单敏感的伊瑟拉。紧随其后出现的，便是妆容娇柔、神色纯良的朝雾白莲，她以志同道合的友人身份接近伊瑟拉，顺理成章地成为对方无话不谈的闺蜜。
一幕幕相处的画面缓缓展开，两人一唱一和，用虚假的温情编织罗网，一点点获取伊瑟拉全部的信任。观战的六人神色渐渐冷了下来，天野凛星周身的冰金圣光寒意渐浓，眸底的怒意难以掩饰。海月涟音轻轻蹙眉，温润的眉眼染上惋惜与愤慨，琉璃金朵咬了咬下唇，软糯的脸上满是不满。他们此刻终于彻底明白，从初见的那一刻开始，所有的相遇、相识、相交，全都是暗樱女王提前规划好的陷阱。
“朝雾白莲身为暗樱女王的亲生女儿，潜伏在神域各处，专门物色拥有顶级本源的王族子弟。夜狩凌朔则被暗樱势力许以力量与地位，心甘情愿沦为棋子，两人联手，专门针对幽弥布局。”藤咲若织低声开口，声音里带着压抑的寒意，“目标从一开始，就是暝夜璃影家族独一无二的幻影双生本源。”
画面再度剧变，祥和的神域天际突然被大面积的暗黑雾气笼罩，阴冷暴戾的暗黑灵力如同潮水一般从虚空裂隙之中疯狂涌出。尖锐的警报声响彻整片神域，原本安宁的领地瞬间陷入混乱。暗樱女王的身影在黑雾的最高处缓缓浮现，她身姿傲然，周身缠绕着浓黑如墨的毁灭之力，目光冰冷地扫视下方所有王族领地，野心昭然若揭。
“整片神域的本源力量，本就该归于最强者所有。固守旧规，偏安一隅，只会逐渐腐朽。今日，我便要吞尽六域本源，颠覆光明秩序，从此神域与人间，皆由我主宰！”
狂妄的宣言响彻天地，大战瞬间全面爆发。暗樱麾下的暗影军团倾巢而出，与各大王族的守护军团厮杀在一起。兵刃交击的脆响、灵力碰撞的轰鸣、族人的呼喊与惨叫交织在一起，昔日繁华的神域转瞬沦为惨烈的战场。
冰川时珩王族的领地首当其冲，御神苍瞬的族人奋起抵抗，时序与雷霆之力铺天盖地席卷而出，却架不住暗影军团源源不断的攻势，以及暗中早已被收买的内奸偷袭。年幼的冰川艾兰躲在族人身后，亲眼看着至亲长辈为了守护领地、守护她，一个个倒在暗黑灵力之下。雷霆撕裂长空，寒冰冻结大地，却终究没能阻挡家园崩塌的命运。冰川神域覆灭，残存的族人拼尽最后力量，将失去依靠、满心恐惧的她送入空间裂隙，送往人间避难。
水晶城红莲王族、沧澜星土王族、永霜天野王族，一处处领地接连遭受猛攻。各大王族彼此驰援，奋力抵抗，可暗处的阴谋远不止表面的暗影入侵。不少神域内部的修炼者早已被暗樱女王蛊惑收买，临阵倒戈，从内部瓦解防线。战局急转直下，六大王族接连受损，死伤惨重，传承千年的神域文明，在战火与阴谋之中摇摇欲坠。
而在战场的夹缝之中，那场针对伊瑟拉的背叛戏码，如期上演。
战火纷飞扰乱了人心，也为夜狩凌朔与朝雾白莲的行动提供了完美的掩护。五年深情一朝斩断，昔日的温柔尽数化作冰冷的拒绝，相伴多年的闺蜜露出狰狞假面。双重背叛的剧痛击溃了伊瑟拉最后的防线，在她人生最绝望、身心濒临崩溃的时刻，暗樱女王适时出现在她面前，抛出复仇的诱饵。
走投无路的少女签下契约，接受黑化改造，伊瑟拉彻底消失，暗影影侍紫苑梦绪就此诞生。
所有的画面串联成完整的链条，三年神域浩劫、王族覆灭、亲人离世、挚友反目、爱人背叛、少女黑化坠落，桩桩件件，层层递进，没有一处是偶然。从头到尾，这都是暗樱女王耗费数年心血，精心布下的一张覆盖整片神域的巨网。她利用人性的贪婪、情感的弱点、族群的矛盾，分化各大王族，掠夺顶级本源，一步步推进自己统治两界的终极野心。
“原来如此……一切都是预谋。”御神苍瞬收回运转力量的双手，霆蓝的时序雷光缓缓敛入体内，回溯幻境开始逐渐消散，扭曲的空间重新恢复正常，周遭的景象回归到琉光星冕学园的林荫小道。六人退出时光幻境，脚踏实地站在原地，每个人的脸色都异常凝重。
夜见幽弥散去周身的幻影之力，幽紫的眼眸里翻涌着复杂的情绪，过往的伤疤被再度揭开，可这一次，她不再是独自面对。“她谋划多年，先是布局算计我，夺取幻影本源，再借着全面入侵搅乱神域，逐个击破各大王族，吞噬冰、草、水、土、时五大本源。等到六域本源尽数落入她手，光明守护体系彻底崩塌，她便能毫无阻碍地统治神域与人间。”
“野心滔天，手段卑劣到了极致。”天野凛星沉声说道，周身冰金圣光凛冽逼人，“三年前的浩劫不是意外，是她蓄谋已久的侵略。我们流落人间，力量被迫蛰伏，同伴离散，战队残缺，全都在她的算计之内。如今我们六命归一，天启初启，恰好撞破了她最深层的野心，接下来的对峙，将会更加凶险。”
“可我们也不再是三年前孤立无援的王族遗脉了。”海月涟音轻声开口，苍碧的水风灵力温柔流转，“我们全员集结，心意相通，羁绊牢不可破。知晓了全部真相，看清了敌人的真面目，我们的目标也变得无比清晰。守护世间光明，夺回被觊觎的本源，终结暗樱女王的黑暗统治，同时为幽弥讨回公道，这是我们所有人共同的使命。”
琉璃金朵用力点头，粉金色的岩土灵光闪烁，少女软糯的声音里带着前所未有的坚定：“绝对不能让她的阴谋得逞！还有夜狩凌朔和朝雾白莲，他们甘愿沦为帮凶，踩着别人的真心和痛苦往上爬，我们一定要揭穿他们所有的伪装！”
众人正围在一起梳理线索、商议后续计划，一阵故作柔弱的交谈声从不远处的岔路口传来，刻意压低的音量，却又恰好能让六人清晰听见。
“凌朔，刚才远远看到他们了，就是守护者战队的那些人。我心里还是有点不安，之前几次冲突，他们对我们态度都很差，我明明什么坏事都没有做，为什么他们总是针对我们呢？”
是朝雾白莲的声音，语气软糯委屈，眼眶微微泛红，一副受了天大委屈的模样。她依偎在夜狩凌朔身侧，抬手轻轻拽着对方的衣袖，姿态娇弱无辜，完美复刻出纯良小白花的模样。
夜狩凌朔抬手拍了拍她的手背，脸上带着刻意营造的温和，目光却隐晦地扫向六人所在的方向，眼底藏着挑衅与不屑。“别怕，有我在。我们只是正常路过，他们若是无故发难，旁人自然能看清是非曲直。有些人心胸狭隘，揪着过往的一点小事不放，刻意抹黑我们，时间久了，大家都会明白真相。”
两人并肩而立，就站在前方的道路中央，摆明了就是刻意在此等候，假意卖惨，当众表演，想要继续颠倒黑白，博取路人的同情，同时挑衅守护者战队众人。周围零星路过的学园学生察觉到这边的动静，纷纷驻足观望，好奇的目光聚焦在两方人马身上。
围观的人群越来越多，朝雾白莲见状，眼底的得意一闪而逝，脸上的委屈神色愈发浓重，甚至微微低下头，肩头轻轻颤动，仿佛被巨大的压力折磨得难以承受。夜狩凌朔则挺直脊背，摆出一副坦荡大度、不愿计较的姿态，任由对方表演。
周围的议论声也随之慢慢响起，不少学生被眼前这一幕牵动心绪，纷纷交头接耳。几名路过的女生面露不忍，小声感慨起来：“看她这样子，好像真的受了不少委屈，肩膀都在抖，不会是被为难许久了吧？”
“凌朔学长一直护着她，看着也确实像是好心安抚，难不成真的是另外几人态度太过强硬，无端针对他们？”
content_en:
The sunset has soaked every tree-lined road in Ryukou Xingmian Academy. The warm golden-red glow passes through the gaps between the branches and leaves, casting mottled light and shadow on the ground. The figures of the six people walked side by side, and the heavy past they just confided in the student union conference room still lingered heavily in everyone's mind. Yami Yuya revealed all the pain and conspiracy that had been buried for five years, and everyone vowed to seek justice for her. However, the hidden tyrannical power of Yakori Lingshuo and Asagiri Bairen made it clear to everyone that now was definitely not the time to take action rashly.
The evening breeze carried the unique light fragrance of the grass and trees over her shoulders. Yami Yumi, who was walking in the middle of the team, lowered her eyes slightly, and her long purple hair was gently tossed by the wind. The red and purple gradient love bracelet on her wrist was close to her skin, and the warm spiritual energy flowed slowly, continuing to soothe the anger and sourness surging in her heart. The five years of pretense and forbearance were once removed, and the warmth of being fully accepted and sincerely protected by her companions gradually melted away the loneliness and coldness that had persisted around her for many years. She turned her head and inadvertently met the gaze of the god beside her, Cang Shun. His bright blue eyes were clear and calm, with no inquiry or pity, only complete understanding and trust.
The Goddess Cangshun has personally experienced the tragedy of the collapse of the divine realm and the death of her people since she was a child. She is also burdened with a devastated past. She understands better than anyone the pain of being wrapped up in fate and being plotted by darkness. The two people's eyes met for a brief moment, and they could already understand each other's myriad thoughts without the need for words. Yushen Cangshun was the first to look away, looking at the buildings in the distance, and a cold voice slowly sounded.
"Only relying on verbal inferences and scattered spiritual exploration, we still cannot see clearly the complete layout of the Queen of Dark Sakura. Yokari Lingshuo and Asagiri Bailian have been rooted in the shadows for many years, and their strength is deeply hidden. Knowing what happened to Yumi alone is not enough to piece together all the truth. The catastrophe that swept through the entire God's Domain three years ago seemed to be a disaster intertwined with wars outside the territory and shadow invasions. If you think carefully about the conspiracy we learned today, there is something fishy in it."
These words instantly stopped the people walking forward, and the originally relaxed atmosphere became solemn again. Amano Rinsei suppressed the fleeting tenderness in his eyes, and his ice-blue eyes were covered with a layer of sharp scrutiny. As the tactical core of the team, he captured the key information in the words immediately.
"You mean that the catastrophe that caused the destruction of the entire divine domain and the dispersion of all the royal families three years ago was not just a simple power dispute from the beginning, but a huge conspiracy planned by Queen Dark Sakura?"
"More than that." Yushen Cangshun took two steps forward slowly, and a faint thundering blue time-series thunder light began to linger around his body. The fine electric light flickered between his hair and clothes, "My origin controls the power of time and thunder, and I can use my spiritual power to look back on the past. Fragments of time in the past. Youmi has the twin origins of phantom and shadow. The power of illusion can build a virtual and real channel that connects the past and the present. If the two of us combine our powers, we can completely recreate everything that happened in the divine realm three years ago. "
When Yami Yumi heard the words, the purple phantom spiritual power around her body rose up. Translucent light and shadow stretched layer by layer around her, and the intertwined lines of reality and reality outlined a hazy barrier in the air. "The power of phantom builds a space-time illusion and takes over your time sequence. The linkage of the two forces can indeed be traced back to the entire process of the God's Domain war three years ago. Now that all members are bonded and resonate, the origin of the Apocalypse has taken root. The fusion of our powers will not cause the hidden danger of spiritual disorder. It is just a good opportunity to uncover all the secrets buried by the years."
Fujisaki Wakaori took half a step forward, his crimson eyes full of solemnity, and the spiritual energy intertwined with the vegetation and flames around him quietly spread out, forming a gentle protective barrier that enveloped everyone. "We will go together, and everyone will witness the truth of the past with our own eyes. Queen Dark Sakura's ambitious plan involves many things. Only by seeing the whole story clearly can our subsequent plans and counterattacks be foolproof. Lianyin, Jin Duo, you two should be prepared for defense and endurance. If you are attacked by the remaining dark viciousness in the past during the traceback process, immediately prop up the joint shield."
Haiyue Lianyin nodded gently, the blue water and wind spiritual energy flowed around her body, and the waves and breeze intertwined into a flexible barrier. The pink-gold colored rock and earth aura of the Glazed Golden Flower is firmly rooted in the ground, and the gold and stone patterns spread along the ground, locking the entire area firmly to prevent outside interference. "Don't worry, Senior Wakaori, leave the defense and healing to us, and we won't let anyone get hurt on the way back."
The six people stood in the center of the avenue in an encirclement, with their spiritual energy connected to each other. The origins of the six domains slowly flowed according to the trajectory of the Apocalypse Star Array. Ice gold holy light, crimson fire spirit, blue water wind, pink gold rock soil, purple phantom, and thundering blue time sequence, six brightly colored spiritual powers are intertwined and intertwined to form a translucent composite light array. The light of the Apocalypse stars in the sky and the earth falls quietly and merges into the light array, adding another layer of solid protection to this power that transcends time.
"Are you ready?" Yu Shen Cang Shun looked at Yami Yumi beside him, his blue eyes looked serious.
"You can start at any time." Yami Yumi nodded slightly, moved his fingertips slightly, and the power of the purple phantom spread out first. The translucent illusion field spread outwards with the two people as the center. The surrounding scenery began to distort slightly, and layers of ripples appeared in the air.
The next moment, Yu Shen Cang raised his hands in an instant, and rich lightning blue light rose from his palms, and the power of timing spread along the lines of the light array. "Retrospective time and electricity, start!"
A roaring low sound resounded inside the illusion, and the invisible power of time pulled at everyone's perceptions. The modern school scene in front of them peeled off layer by layer like a broken mirror. The warm glow, camphor trees, teaching buildings, and tree-lined paths all dissipated, replaced by the vast and majestic ancient divine realm.
Wherever you look, Qiong Towers and Yuyu stand in the sky, and the floating mountains are endless. The heaven and earth are filled with pure and rich original spiritual power. The halo of power exclusive to the royal family is intertwined in the sky, creating a scene of prosperity, peace and tranquility. This is the entire divine realm that had not suffered a catastrophe three years ago. The six royal families live in separate regions, staying together for generations, watching each other, and jointly maintaining the order and balance of the divine realm and the human world.
The figures of everyone turned into invisible light and shadow, floating in mid-air. As bystanders, they overlooked the entire God's Domain. They would not interfere with any of the past trajectories, but they could clearly see everything that happened in front of them.
The first thing that caught the eye was the territory of the Mingye Liying royal family. Purple light and shadow spread across the entire territory, and the power of phantoms and shadows intertwined to form a unique protective barrier. At that time, the young Ysera still had bright eyebrows, and there was no trace of the aloofness and coldness in her body that she would become later. She shuttled nimbly between tribes, chatting and laughing with her fellow tribesmen, her eyes full of pure smiles and longing for the future. At that time, she had not yet met Ye Shou Lingshuo, and had not yet stepped into that carefully woven scam, but she still had her own warmth and belonging.
Looking at himself as he was in the past, Yami Yuya's figure sluggished slightly, his fingertips unconsciously tightened, and complex and unspeakable emotions surged in his heart. Fujisaki Wakaori noticed something strange about her, quietly moved the light and shadow to get closer, silently raised his hand, and used the spiritual power of the plants and trees to turn into a gentle warmth to soothe her restless mind. Yami Yumi turned his head to look at her, shook his head slightly to indicate that he was fine, and looked back at the scene below.
The picture flows and time continues to move forward. Ysera walked out of the Mingye Liying royal family's territory and met Ye Shou Lingshuo, who deliberately pretended to be gentle, for the first time in the market at the border of the divine realm. At that time, the man's eyebrows were warm, his speech was modest, and every move he made showed just the right amount of thoughtfulness and care, and he was getting closer to the lonely and sensitive Ysera step by step. The next person who appeared was Asagiri Hakuren with delicate makeup and innocent expression. She approached Ysera as a like-minded friend and naturally became her best friend who talked about everything.
Scenes of getting along slowly unfolded. The two sang and harmonized, weaving a web of false warmth, and gained Ysera's full trust little by little. The expressions of the six people watching the battle gradually became colder. The ice-gold holy light around Amano Rinxing became increasingly chilly, and the anger in his eyes could not be concealed. Haiyue Lianyin frowned slightly, her gentle eyebrows stained with regret and indignation. Liuli Jinduo bit her lower lip, her soft face full of dissatisfaction. At this moment, they finally fully understood that from the moment they first met, all encounters, acquaintances, and interactions were all traps planned by Queen Dark Sakura in advance.
"Asagiri Hakuren, as the biological daughter of Queen Dark Sakura, lurks throughout the divine domain, specifically looking for royal children with top-level origins. Lingshuo Yokari was promised power and status by the Dark Sakura forces, and was willing to become a pawn. The two joined forces to specifically target Yumi's layout." Fujisaki Wakaori spoke in a low voice, with a suppressed chill in his voice, "The target has been the unique phantom twin origin of the Akiya Liying family from the beginning."
The scene changed drastically again, and the peaceful sky of God's Domain was suddenly shrouded in a large area of dark mist, and cold and violent dark spiritual power poured out from the cracks in the void like a tide. The shrill alarm sounded throughout the entire God's Domain, and the originally peaceful territory instantly fell into chaos. The figure of the Dark Sakura Queen slowly emerged from the highest point of the black mist. Her figure was proud, and her body was wrapped with the power of destruction as black as ink. Her eyes were coldly scanning all the royal territories below, and her ambition was clearly revealed.
"The original power of the entire divine realm should belong to the strongest. Sticking to the old rules and settling in a corner will only gradually decay. Today, I will swallow up the origin of the six realms and subvert the order of light. From now on, both the divine realm and the human world will be controlled by me!"
Arrogant declarations resounded throughout the world, and the war broke out in an instant. The shadow legions under Dark Sakura came out in full force and fought with the guardian legions of the major royal families. The crisp sound of weapons clashing, the roar of spiritual collision, and the shouts and screams of the clansmen were intertwined, and the once prosperous God's Domain suddenly turned into a tragic battlefield.
The territory of the Heng royal family in Glacier Time bore the brunt of the attack. The people of the Royal God Cang Shun rose up to resist. The power of Time and Thunder swept out overwhelmingly, but they could not withstand the continuous offensive of the Shadow Army and the sneak attacks of the traitors who had been bribed secretly. The young Glacier Ailan hid behind her clan members and watched with her own eyes as her relatives and elders fell to the dark spiritual power one by one in order to protect their territory and protect her. Thunder tore through the sky and ice froze the earth, but in the end they could not stop the fate of their homeland from collapsing. The Glacier God Realm was destroyed, and the remaining tribesmen used their last strength to send her, who had no support and was filled with fear, into a rift in space and took refuge in the human world.
The Crystal City Red Lotus Royal Clan, the Canglan Star Earth Royal Clan, and the Yongshuang Amano Royal Clan all suffered from fierce attacks on their territories one after another. The major royal families rushed to support each other and resisted vigorously, but the conspiracy behind the scenes was far more than the superficial shadow invasion. Many cultivators within the God's Domain have already been bewitched and bribed by Queen Dark Sakura, and have turned against them in the face of battle, collapsing the defense line from within. The war situation took a turn for the worse, and the six royal families suffered heavy casualties one after another. The civilization of the Divine Realm, which had been inherited for thousands of years, was crumbling in the flames of war and conspiracy.
And in the cracks of the battlefield, the betrayal drama against Ysera took place as scheduled.
The raging war disturbed people's hearts and provided perfect cover for the actions of Ye Shou Ling Shuo and Asagiri Bai Lian. After five years of deep love, all the tenderness in the past turned into cold rejection, and the best friend who had been with him for many years showed his ferocious mask. The pain of double betrayal broke Ysera's last line of defense. At the most desperate moment in her life, when she was on the verge of physical and mental collapse, the Dark Sakura Queen appeared in front of her at the right time, throwing out the bait of revenge.
The desperate girl signed a contract and accepted the dark transformation. Ysera disappeared completely, and the shadow servant Shion Yumeo was born.
All the scenes are connected in a complete chain, including three years of catastrophe in the divine realm, the destruction of the royal family, the death of relatives, the betrayal of close friends, the betrayal of lovers, and the darkening of a young girl. Everything is progressing layer by layer, and nothing is accidental. From beginning to end, this is a giant network that Queen Dark Sakura has spent years of hard work and carefully laid covering the entire God's Domain. She takes advantage of human greed, emotional weakness, and ethnic conflicts to divide the major royal families, plunder the top sources, and step by step advance her ultimate ambition to rule the two worlds.
"I see... everything was premeditated." Yushen Cangshun retracted his hands that were operating the power, and Tinglan's time-series lightning slowly entered his body. The illusion of retrospection began to gradually dissipate, the distorted space returned to normal, and the surrounding scene returned to the tree-lined paths of Liuguang Xingmian Academy. The six people exited the illusion of time and stood there with their feet on the ground. Everyone's expressions were extremely solemn.
Seeing Yumi dissipate the phantom power around her body at night, complex emotions surged in Yumi's purple eyes, and the scars from the past were revealed again, but this time, she was no longer facing it alone. "She has been planning for many years. She first plotted against me to seize the origin of phantom, and then used a full-scale invasion to disrupt the divine realm, defeating the major royal families one by one, and devouring the five origins of ice, grass, water, earth, and time. When all the origins of the six realms fall into her hands and the light guardian system completely collapses, she will be able to rule the divine realm and the human world without any hindrance."
"The ambition is monstrous, and the means are extremely despicable." Amano Rinxing said in a deep voice, the ice-gold holy light around him was sharp and threatening. "The catastrophe three years ago was not an accident, but her long-planned invasion. We were living in the world, our strength was forced to lie dormant, our companions were separated, and the team was incomplete. It was all within her plan. Now that our six lives are unified, the apocalypse has begun, which happened to break through her deepest ambitions, and the subsequent confrontation will be even more dangerous."
"But we are no longer the isolated and helpless royal family three years ago." Haiyue Lianyin spoke softly, and the spiritual power of the blue water wind gently circulated, "We are all gathered together, our hearts are connected, and our bond is unbreakable. Knowing the whole truth, see After knowing the true face of the enemy, our goal has become extremely clear. Protecting the light in the world, regaining the coveted origin, ending the dark rule of the Dark Sakura Queen, and seeking justice for Yumi, this is the common mission of all of us."
Liuli Jinduo nodded vigorously, the pink-gold rock and earth aura flickered, and the girl's soft voice was filled with unprecedented firmness: "We must not let her conspiracy succeed! There are also Yekari Lingshuo and Asagiri Bailian, they are willing to become accomplices and climb up on the sincerity and pain of others. We must expose all their disguises!"
As everyone gathered together to sort out clues and discuss follow-up plans, a soft sound of conversation came from a fork in the road not far away. The volume was deliberately lowered, but it was just enough for the six people to hear clearly.
"Ling Shuo, I saw them from a distance just now. They are the people from the Guardian Team. I still feel a little uneasy. They had a bad attitude towards us in the previous conflicts. I obviously didn't do anything bad. Why do they always target us?"
It was the voice of Chaogiri Bailian, her tone was soft and aggrieved, her eyes were slightly red, and she looked like she had been greatly wronged. She snuggled next to Ye Shou Lingshuo, raised her hand and gently tugged on his sleeve, her posture was delicate and innocent, perfectly replicating the appearance of a pure and innocent little white flower.
Ye Shou Lingshuo raised his hand and patted the back of her hand, with a deliberately gentle look on his face, but his eyes vaguely glanced in the direction of the six people, with provocation and disdain hidden in his eyes. "Don't be afraid, I'm here. We are just passing by normally. If they attack for no reason, others will naturally be able to see clearly. Some people are narrow-minded and hold on to little things in the past to deliberately discredit us. As time goes by, everyone will understand the truth."
The two stood side by side in the middle of the road ahead. It was clear that they were waiting here deliberately, pretending to be miserable and performing in public. They wanted to continue to confuse right and wrong, win the sympathy of passers-by, and at the same time provoke everyone in the Guardian team. The sporadically passing academy students noticed the commotion here and stopped to watch, their curious eyes focused on the two groups.
There were more and more people watching. When Chao Wu Bailian saw this, the pride in his eyes flashed away, and the look of grievance on his face became more intense. He even lowered his head slightly, and his shoulders shook slightly, as if he was tortured by the huge pressure and was unbearable. Ye Shou Lingshuo straightened his back, assumed a magnanimous and generous attitude, and let the other party perform.
The surrounding discussions also gradually started, and many students were affected by the scene in front of them and whispered among themselves. Several girls passing by showed unbearable expressions and sighed softly: "Looking at her like this, she seems to have suffered a lot of grievances. Her shoulders are shaking. Could it be that she has been embarrassed for a long time?"
"Senior Lingshuo has been protecting her and seems to be kind-hearted in comforting her. Could it be that the other people are too tough and are targeting them for no reason?"
